detail.longDescription: I was training a linear SVM classifier in MATLAB on a multi-class biometric dataset ( K > 2 classes). When running fitcsvm inside a cross-validation loop: mdl = fitcsvm(X_train, Y_train, 'KernelFunction', 'linear', 'Standardize', true); I got the following runtime error: Error using ClassificationSVM.prepareData (line 721) Use fitcecoc to train a linear model with more than 2 classes. How do I properly replace fitcsvm with fitcecoc and templateSVM for multi-class classification using a linear kernel?
